## Dev selection

8 configs; dev baseline sv 55.2, en 66.9. Chosen: L12 α=0.5 (sv 57.7). Tied on sv accuracy: L12 α=0.5 (en 67.5), L16 α=1.0 (en 69.2). The tie was broken by sweep order (first max), not by a stated rule.

## Post-hoc exploratory checks (not preregistered)

- Baseline re-run with current code reproduces the saved per-question test results exactly: {'sv': True, 'en': True}
- Baseline correctness flips, batch size 2 vs 4: {'sv': 13, 'en': 6}
- Real edits re-run with current code reproduce the saved per-question test results exactly: {'0.5': {'sv': True, 'en': True}, '1.0': {'sv': True, 'en': True}}
